references.text: The same chapter introduces the laws concerning a certificate of divorce (sefer keritut), which verse 3 refers back to
Priests were forbidden to marry divorced women, demonstrating the serious nature of divorce in the Mosaic Law
A priest's daughter who was divorced had to return to her father's house, relating to the woman's situation after divorce
The prophet Isaiah uses the metaphor of a certificate of divorce to describe Israel's relationship with God
Jeremiah refers to God's certificate of divorce to Israel due to unfaithfulness
Jesus quotes and comments on this law regarding certificates of divorce in the Sermon on the Mount
Jesus discusses Moses' permission for certificates of divorce with the Pharisees and explains its original intent
Mark recounts Jesus' discussion about the certificate of divorce that Moses allowed
